prompt:
You are a equity research analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-02-05, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock.
Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-02-05):
Price action as of 2026-02-05: 1w +3.7%, 1m +10.1%, 3m +29.3%. Last close 186.50. 21d annualized realized volatility 32%. Position in trailing 63-day range: 93% (0%=low, 100%=high).
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock exhibits strong positive price momentum across all short-to-medium-term horizons (up 29.3% over 3 months and 10.1% over 1 month) and is trading near the very top of its 63-day range (93rd percentile). Supported by a healthy 32% annualized realized volatility, this robust uptrend suggests strong buying pressure and positive sentiment that is highly likely to persist over a 20-trading-day tactical horizon. 

DECISION: BUY
